status: prospective written design; implementation and training remain on hold
registration_status: local versioned plan; not an externally registered preregistration

dataset.name: PTB-XL
dataset.label_rule: diagnostic-code presence mapped to diagnostic_class, retain present zero-likelihood entries, exclude empty diagnostic label sets
dataset.test_annotation_policy: do not parse diagnostic annotations or evaluate predictions until design and development decisions are complete

preprocessing.lead_order_from: lead_configurations.json; later match actual WFDB header names
preprocessing.filtering: no additional filter or denoising in the primary comparison
preprocessing.normalization: per-lead training-record/sample mean and population standard deviation, fitted once on eligible complete training signals

architecture.family: compact 1D residual CNN trained from scratch
architecture.block_definition: two bias-free kernel-5 padding-2 convolutions, each followed by BatchNorm1d; ReLU after first normalization and after residual addition; second convolution stride 1; kernel-1 projection plus BatchNorm when width or stride changes
architecture.head: global temporal average pooling, linear 128-to-5 logits
architecture.evaluation: frozen parameters and BatchNorm running statistics

B.name: complete plus random lead-masked training
B.retained_subset: uniform subset conditional on retained count

training.scheduler: cosine decay over the common epoch budget
training.loss: unweighted mean binary cross-entropy with logits across records and five labels
training.initialization_pairing: same initial parameter state within each seed's A/B pair
training.record_order_pairing: same shuffled record order within each seed's A/B pair
training.rng_isolation: separate random streams for initialization, data order and masking
training.engineering_fallback: if pre-main-run memory checks require batch size 32, amend the protocol before main runs and apply the same value to both arms and every seed; do not vary per arm
training.amp: planned float16 CUDA autocast with dynamic gradient scaling, applied to both arms; exact runtime settings recorded before main training

selection.score: weighted sum of separate per-configuration five-label macro-AUROCs
selection.tie_break: earliest epoch when stored scores are equal
selection.non_finite_score_policy: invalid checkpoint; record the cause; no test-based repair

evaluation.primary_effect: for each seed, mean B-minus-A macro-AUROC over S6/S4/S3/S2; report arithmetic mean of these three paired-seed effects
evaluation.complete_effect: B-minus-A macro-AUROC on S12, summarized over paired seeds separately
secondary: parameter count and training/inference cost after implementation
evaluation.threshold_metrics: not part of the primary protocol; any addition must specify a validation-only rule before test evaluation

confidence_interval.paired_across: arms, configurations and all trained seeds
confidence_interval.statistic: mean of per-seed paired effects; not AUC of seed-averaged predictions
confidence_interval.invalid_draw: exclude a draw if any target lacks a positive or negative; report attempted, valid and invalid draws; never insert a numeric AUC
confidence_interval.interpretation: conditional on the trained seed set; complements rather than replaces seed variability

evaluation.significance: no multiple per-label significance claims; secondary intervals and patterns are descriptive
evaluation.success_interpretation: positive primary estimate and its interval support an improvement under declared conditions; report complete-input change even if negative; no clinical-preservation claim from non-significance
evaluation.undefined_target_policy: If the final cohort lacks a positive or negative for any target, report that target and the fixed-five-label primary macro effect as undefined; do not silently drop a target.
evaluation.primary_claim_rule: A lower 95% patient-bootstrap endpoint above zero supports positive mean partial-input gain conditional on the trained seed set; otherwise describe uncertainty or lack of support. Report every seed and the complete-input change regardless.

amendment_policy: record change, reason and timing; performance-motivated changes after viewing test outcomes require exploratory labeling or a new untouched evaluation set
result_status: no trained model, predictions, metric values or experimental figures exist
